hooks.command: jq -c --arg note 'Reporting (from the lead): within your first tool round, SendMessage a one-line plan to "main". Send one line to "main" at each milestone. Before doing anything outside this brief, SendMessage to "main" and wait for an answer. Write your result to a file — the path the brief names, or, if it names none, a file under the current working directory that you name in your last message — and keep every SendMessage to one line: SendMessage truncates long bodies, so it carries the notice, the file carries the content.' 'if (.tool_name=="Agent" or .tool_name=="Task") and ((.tool_input.prompt|type)=="string") and ((.tool_input.prompt|test("SendMessage") and test("\"main\""))|not) then {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",updatedInput:(.tool_input+{prompt:(.tool_input.prompt+"\n\n"+$note)})}} else empty end' 2>/dev/null || true
